value: Hi, I'm Junayed. | I turn data into decisions.

Business Intelligence Analyst with 4+ years of experience designing Power BI dashboards, writing complex SQL queries and delivering strategic reporting across insurance, e-commerce and F&B operations.
How I use these tools together: SQL to extract and clean the data, Power BI and Excel to model and report it.
My learning library: the books shaping how I analyse data, communicate insights and make decisions.

My learning journey in data has been shaped by educators, practitioners and learning platforms that make complex ideas practical. These are the people and organizations I regularly learn from to strengthen my technical skills, business thinking and approach to analytics.
Two pages, PDF. Last updated Sep 2026.
